datasheet_revision_note: Cover B/2, headers B/1; dated 2025-11-22. Procurement must match functions and dimensions, not just the legacy MINI-E title.
sourcing_decision: No orderable 5 mA reverse-mount part was verified. Use the documented 12 mA package in the engineering candidate, with explicit power analysis; do not call it a 5 mA part.

design_screens.limitations: Typical idle lacks a maximum; synchronized PWM peaks, 4 V logic/optical behavior, inrush and thermal behavior are not qualified by this arithmetic. Existing unqualified-firmware LED interlock remains.

jlc_assembly: SMT, Standard Only, High assembly difficulty, MSL5a per fetched listing; reverse orientation and revised land geometry need assembly review

pwm_frequency_kHz.qualification: No guaranteed PWM period or relative phase is provided.

power_transient_screen.case: 64 key LEDs, RGB code 5 each, underglow dark: PWM sum 960, within existing 1020 limit
power_transient_screen.limitations: Sensitivity screen assuming aligned phases and channel current held at datasheet maximum; not a guaranteed 4 V waveform. Real current collapses out of compliance. Existing nominal C121 4.7uF plus bypass caps do not establish power integrity. DC bias, ESR, trace impedance, limit dynamics and inrush must be qualified; do not enable unqualified LED power.
